tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ya mān+ta kā ya/ 'dir zla gsang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud las/ yang gsol ba/ e ma hoḥ rang byung ye shes bcom ldan 'das// bde gshegs mchog gi sku gzugs kyi// dbang po'i skyon bsal ji ltar lags// bka' bstsal pa/ gnon po rdo rje khyod nyon cig /lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bde gshegs sku gzugs de dag la// dang po khrus ni gsol bar bya// zhes pa nas/ tshe bdag zla gsang las/ sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang gi le'u ste so brgyad pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i bar/ rab tu gnas pa la lag tu blang ba la gsum/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// sta gon gyi sdom ni/ legs bshams bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas// rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la// bgegs bskrad mchod de dgug gzhug bya// rgyas gdab mchod bstod gtor ma gtang*// snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// rten dbab bdag bsrung sta gon no| |dang po legs par bsham pa ni/ ji skad du/ dpyid zla ra ba dpyid 'bring po// dgun tha dpyid kyi tha chung dang*// dbyar zla ra ba dbyar 'bring po// nyi ma byang du bgrod pa yi// dkar po'i phyogs kyi gnyis pa'am| |de bzhin de'i gsum pa'am// bco lnga de bzhin brgyad pa dang*// bcu gsum pa yang de bzhin no// gang tshe gza' dang rjes mthun na// nag po'i phyogs la'ang brtsam par bya// gnam stong dang ni de bzhin du// nyi shu dgu la bya ba min// zhes dang*/ rgyal dang me bzhi lha mtshams dbo// snar ma ji bzhin mgo dang lag /snron snubs chu stod chu smad dang*// khrums stod khrums smad skar ma dang*// zhes dang*/ gza' lhag phur bu pa wa sangs// zla ba'i gza' rnams zhes bya ba// 'di rnams las byas bzang ldan te// rab tu gnas pa mchog tu dge// nyi ma spen pa mig dmar ni// nor rnams 'joms pas spang bar bya| |zhes gsungs pa'i zla ba dge ba'i tshes gza' skar shis pa rnams rab gnas dngos gzhi'i nyin mo yong bar bya zhing*/

khyad par nyi ma lho bgrod la bab pa/ sreg tshes 'chi sbyor sogs dang biṣ+ṭi chu tshod ma yol ba dang sa bdag gdug pa can rgyu ba sogs med pa'i dus su bya'o// de la'ang sngon du ma sbyangs pa'i sar ni/ sa brtag bslang sbyang gzung bsrung rnams dang*/ sa dang lha bum pa sta gon rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi lhan thabs ltar bya zhing*/ sngon nas sbyangs zin pa'i gnas su ni yang zlog rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bshams/ de dang nye bar khrus kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad rig lnga yab yum bzhi'i sa bon bris pa'i mthar khrus bum gyi rdzas brgyad so sor bskor la bsham/ bum rdzas so so'i mdun du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rang rang gi 'dag chal rnams kyang snod so sor bkod/ 'dag chal brgyad po 'dzom na sran dkar gyi phye ma dri bzang gis sbags pa til mar gyis sbrus pa gcig pus kyang rung ngo*// khrus bum brgyad byed na rdzas kyi mtha' skor la bsham/ pad+ma'i dbus su sngar rab gnas zin pa'i rten byin rlabs can dang*/ gur gum/ gi waṃ/ tsan+dan sogs kyis bris pa'i rten 'brel snying po sogs bsham/ khrus bum gcig byed na khrus dkyil gyi dbus su bsham/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi mdun du mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ mthar bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad sogs dang mchod pa ci 'byor ba bsham/ gzhan yang me long*/ khrus ras/ dūrba'i pir/ sbyang chas/ dbang rdzas/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gam tsā ru'i bza' ba sogs gang dgos kyi yo byad tshogs par 'du bya/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed dang*/ byung na mdun bskyed kyang bya zhing ma byung na skabs 'dir mdun bskyed ma grub kyang nyan no// gsum pa ni/ lha bum gnyis sgrub cing las gshin dang phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bya/

khrus bum bsgrub pa ni/ khrus bum gyi khar gzung thag bzhag la/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs| swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes pas drangs pa'i lha'i gaṅgā'i chu'i ngo bo'i chus gang ba'i nang du so so'i rdzas kyis gang bar gyur par bsam/ thog mar dri sna tshogs blugs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snān pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ de bzhin du/ mngar gsum la/ tri ma dhu/ zho la/ da dhi/ shing thog sna tshogs la/ phal/ 'bru sna tshogs la/ bri hi/ 'bras yos la/ lā dza/ sman sna tshogs la/ au ṣa dhi/ rin po che sna tshogs la/ ma ṇi/ zhes dang*/ thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ yang ci 'grub bzla/ mthar/ rdzas so so zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa sbyang ba la/ zhi ba/ phyed ma/ drag po/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang bzhi las/ zhi bas sbyang ba ni/ gtor ma dang ting lo chang bu rnams chus sbyangs/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor chung re re nas rten la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs brjod cing snod du dor/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni/ ting lo re re nas rten la g.yon du bskor zhing dril bu gsil bas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod/ drag pos sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum/ khro gnyer mche gtsigs phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can klu brgyad kyis spras pa/

rdor dril 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis sna tshogs pad nyir bsgyings pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐ */ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ sngags de'i wā ra'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ */ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug can rtsad nas 'joms mdzad cing*// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog

/khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ */ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ rje btsun rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar gcod rtsom pa'i bgegs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis mgo bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas shing brlag par gdon mi za'o// zhes dang*/ khro bo'i drag sngags brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /gtor ma dang ting lo phyi rol du dor ro// sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mdun du me chu til bkod la/ rang dang yon bdag gi rkang zhabs rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar| des snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po gnas par sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus pa gdungs te sna nas thon til la thim par gyur/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pas spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag mo zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdor dril 'dzin pa/

phyag rgya drug dang mgo phreng stag lpags kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis gnas par gsal ba'i ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i zhal du phul bas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes mtheb srin gyis til thogs pa g.yas kyis g.yas dang g.yon gyis g.yon du bskor la me chur dor ba lan 'ga' bya/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ yig brgyas chad lhag bskang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pas rten rnams kyi dbu la gdugs phub cing bkru zhing phyis par gyur par bsam/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// 'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa sgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul ba bgyi| |oṃ āḥta pa tre hūm̐/ gis gdugs dbul/ rten spyan drang du btub na khrus stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bzhag la/ spyan 'dren mi thub na rten gyi mdun du khrus stegs kyi khar khrus gzhong bzhag la bkru/ dngos su bkrur mi btub na me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba bkru ste/ thog mar las bum thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o| |las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/

chos dbyings dag pa'i sku la spro bsdu mi mnga' yang*// sa dang nam mkha' de bzhin bar snang la// sems can don phyir bde gshegs sku gsung thugs sprul ba| |khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir// rin chen 'bru dang snying po spos la sogs// mkhyen gsal ye shes thob phyir sku khrus gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sems can las kyi bag chags dag bya'i phyir// sna tshogs yid 'ong rin chen chu rgyun gyis// bde gshegs sku la zla ltar bsil bar bgyi// sam+bhog kā ya sa ma ya shrī ye hoḥ zhes dang khrus ras la dri bzang gis rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pas phyi zhing*/ 'jam dbyangs sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sems can dri ma sel phyir rnga yab dang*// kha tshar ma mnyam ras kyis sku phyis pas// sems can las kyi bag chags byang gyur cig /nirmā ṇa kā ya shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes zla gsang gi rgyud las gsungs pa dang*/ slar las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/ skal bzang ldan pa 'chi med dgyes// mchog tu mdzes pa'i cha byad can// rdo rje slob dpon dpal mchog la// bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ khrus ras kyis phyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ ma rig 'joms pa'i nyi ma ste| |srid pa'i nad ni sel ba'i sman// dam chos rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid can// mchog gi yon tan gzugs brnyan gyi// mchod rten rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ bskal pa mtha' yi dngos 'joms pa// 'jigs byed me yi cha byad can// mgon po snying rje'i stobs ldan la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ mchog tu tshim zhing bskal pa bzang*// dam pa'i bdud rtsi'i mdzes cha can// dge 'dun rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā| gdul bya'i sems can gang dag la// rgyal ba'i sprul sku mang po yi// lha yi cha byad can rnams la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ snying rje yis ni nges gang ba// rtag tu phan dang bde mdzad pa// mchog tu dul ba de dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gnas dang ni// slob pa dge 'dun gnas kyi sa// gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de nas khrus bum gyis khrus pa'i thog mar/ n+ya gro dha/ u duṃ wā ra/ p+lak+ṣa/ bi pa la/ gan+dha mudha ste 'o ma can gyi shing lngas dril phyis byed par gsungs kyang de dag bod du rnyed dka' bas 'o ma can cha 'dra ba lu+u dang*/ 'om bu/ kham bu/ lcang skya/ shug pa/ thang shing rnams gang 'dzom gyi phye ma dūr+wa'i pir gyis byug drud bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/

lan gsum gyis byug drud bya/ 'dag chal brgyad po byug drud bya ba'i snga rol du til mar dri bzang dang sbyar ba byug dgos par gsungs pa ni 'dag chal brgyad ka'i so so'i sngon du lan re bya'o// mchan/ sngags dang dūrba'i pir gyis byug drud ni 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar la rdzas ni so so yin no// de nyid dri sna tshogs kyi bum chus bkru zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bkru/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ traṃ' hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes khrus ras kyis phyi ba'ang 'og rnams la sbyar ro// zho 'o ma mar sbrang rtsi ka ra ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lngas byug cing*/ mngar gsum gyi bum pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ma dhu pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ ba byung lngas byug cing zho'i bum pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta da dhi pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ dri sna tshogs chu gtsang la sbyar bas byug cing*/

shing thog gi bum pas/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bsrung ba dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o| |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta phal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ sngar gyi 'o ma can gyi shing shun gyis byug cing*/ 'bru'i bum pas/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// byams pa dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bri hi pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrā'iḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ skyu ru ra'i phye mas byug cing*/ 'bras yos kyi bum pas/ rje sgom pa spyan snga bkras rnam pa'i rab gnas su/ shing thog gi bum pa'i 'dag chal shing shun dang 'bru'i bum pa'i 'dag chal dri zhim po'i 'bru mar gyi bya bar gsung 'dug go// 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// nan tan dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lā dza pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ yung ba'i phye mas byug cing*/ sman sna tshogs kyi bum pas/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// ting 'dzin dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta au ṣa dhi pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ gur gum/ a ga ru/ gla rtsi/ ga pur/ tsan+dan te dri lngas byug cing*/ rin po che'i bum pas/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// ye shes dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de nas khrus bum brgyad yod na 'di phyin gyi khrus rkyang rnams dri sna tshogs kyi bum pa kho nas bya zhing*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing*// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos| |gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de nas 'di ltar/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam sbyong dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' ba| |gsung gtsang gtsang mar dag pa des/

khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des| |khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung zhing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// sangs rgyas khyod la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyod la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kyi ni bsam pa yis// khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong rnams kyang bde legs shing*// khyod cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces dang*/ spro na/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyang bya/ slar las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol| |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas sku khrus gsol zhing*/

de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ gos zung 'bul zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' dam pa shin tu dri zhim pa// gos bzang srab ma 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rten rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ya ma ti ra baṃ zhes pa nas/ 'khor dang nor rdzas thams cad gsal bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar gtso rkyang ngam/ rgyas par na/ rbad ya zlog ya zhes pas bskor bar gyur gyi bar yab yum sras sprul lnga ga bskyed pa gang 'dod/ rang nyid ces pa dang*/ rang tshe bdag tu gsal pa'i zhes pa dor/ de rjes/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur par bsam/ bdun pa spyan drang ba ni/ rang dang rten gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dam tshig pa lta bu'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/ rdor dril spos bcas thogs nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'jam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// dus kyi khams bzhin thugs rje 'gro 'ong bral// sprul pa 'gro dang bral ba gzugs brnyan bzhin// chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang ba// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i lha// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras sprul las byed 'khor tshogs bcas// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol| |zhes spyan drangs/

phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sarba bhū ta uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐/ dang*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni'i sngags dang yungs kar gyis brab la bskrad/ slar yang*/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi sogs kyis sku khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ slar yang*/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'dir ni mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don slad du// bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa dang*// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin rlob cing*| |'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs// oṃ ya mān+ta kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥ de bzhin du/ dzaḥphyi ma'i mal du hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes so sor btags pa brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la dgug bcing mnyes dbang du byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de gsum ga rus pa dang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi gar gyis bzhengs par gyur par bsam/ dgu pa mchod cing bstod nas gtor ma gtang ba ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byas la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub cing*// zhing khams rgya mtsho mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yon tan rgya mtsho rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// dad pa rgya mtshos dbul lo dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi mal du| zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai+ai wi d+ye/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta sbyar bas sman raka gtor gsum phul nas/ thabs mchog bde chen ma sbas lha gnyis sbyar bas bstod/ gtor ma gtang ba ni/ 'das pa'i gtor ma drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgya dang*/ de rjes lha sngags la gtor 'bul gyi sngags btags pas dbul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma las gshin chos skyong bco lnga dang bcas par/ gtor ma dbang chog bdud dpung zin gnon ltar dbul/ grub na lha rnams tshim pa'i slad du skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o// bcu pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ rdor dril spos dang bcas pa thogs/ pus mo btsugs la/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ 'jam dpal khro rgyal bcom ldan 'das// rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba// kun gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir// bdag ni che ge rdo rje yis// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor ba dag gis// rab gnas nangs par bgyid par 'tshal// tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ slar mchod bstod ci rigs bya'o// bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ ya ma rā dza'i yig rgya lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥbadz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha/ rten gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes ye shes par phyag bya/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rten dam tshig par gsal ba'i thugs ka dang*/ dbu dang*/ mgul dang*/ phyag gnyis dang*/ spyi gtsug rnams su dris byugs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas nas/ las gshin gyi sngags bzla zhing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pas rten la lan gsum reg la/ slar gtso bo'i sngags dang las sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes rdo rje go cha'i sngags rgyas rten bsrung*/ bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra hūm̐/ zhes rten la na bza' ser po g.yogs/ bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes rang gi gnas gsum du rdo rjes reg la bsrung*/ skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor bya/ mdun bskyed byas na de nyid dang*/ bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu byas la/ rang nyid lha phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal lo// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sdom ni/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod// rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab| |rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab// dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya// gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya// de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang*// sbyin sreg sngags te dngos bzhi'o// zhes pa'i dang po tho rangs kyi char mchod gtor gsar pa rgya cher bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rgyas par bsgom zhing bzlas pa byas nas thun bsdus la/

phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis mdun bskyed dang lha bum khrus bum rnams sgrub cing mchod/ bzlas pa gtor 'bul rnams byas rjes dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa brtsams te dbang bzhi pa'i bar bdag 'jug blangs/ de rjes gnang ba zhu zhing bden pa'i byin rlabs bya/ tshogs byin gyis brlabs nas tshogs lhag yan grub par bya'o// gnyis pa rten sbyang ba/ gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba rnams ni sngar sta gon gyi dus kho na ltar 'dir bya/ bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ ye dharma he tu sogs dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes lan ci rigs brjod/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dbang stegs lta bu'i gdan gyi steng du rten bzhugs su gsol nas/ spos sreg /rol mo bsgrags/ me tog 'thor zhing bsgrengs bas/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/

de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pas nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum bya/ slar/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/

myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ zhes lan gsum byas la/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'chi'o| |de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyis pas de'i mthus bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo*// 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o// phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o// sems can thams cad bag chags kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do// 'chi ba'i nyi ma phye mar brlag go// ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o// ma dad pa dang*/ phyi rol pa dag dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log pa yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro// las kyi chu bo las ldog par bgyi'o// srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o// chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o// byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o// bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do// bsam gtan gyi bde ba la brtser bstsal te// 'dod chags kyi me dpung gzhil bar bgyi'o// zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o| |bden pa la gzud do// phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o// ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o// sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o// 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o// de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub gyi mchog stsol cing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes me tog mthor zhing lan gsum gyi bar bya'o// drug pa rten bskyed pa/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs zhing bgegs bskrad nas mchod cing*/ sngar sta gon gyi dus nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye shes pa'ang skabs 'dir bstim par dmigs/ mchan/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa rnams sta gon gyi dus ltar 'dir bya'o// rgyas par na dbang gi 'jug pa nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar dkyus ji lta ba dang*/ 'bring du na 'jug pa nas brtsam bzhi pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ mtha' rten rnam bzhag nas/ dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bya la/ bsdu na/ rang gi snying gi sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha dang lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ na bza' rnams rten gyi steng phyogs su 'dzin cing glu gar mdzad/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sgrog /me tog gur gu+um la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bsrung*/ rig ma rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu len/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ rgyal ba rigs lngas phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu bsnams nas dbang bskur bar gyur par bsam| bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /ces dang*/

rnam rgyal bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum pa mgor bzhag /bum chu gtor/ dbu rgyan thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa buṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ dharma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes mgo bo'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir bzhag /oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum chu 'thor/ rdo rje thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi// dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje bzung*| |oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes rdo rje snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing lag g.yas su gtad/ bum chu 'thor/ dril bu thogs nas/ oṃ/ dril bu shes rab dang ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyas nos shig /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dril bu lag g.yon du gtad/ bum chu 'thor/ rdor dril mnyam por spyi bor bzhag la/ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rjer rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan pa// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro| |oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ kye dpal hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa khyod/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ bum chu 'thor/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/

zhes lag g.yas su gtad/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon du gtad/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod| |gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyad pas// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes phyag rgya gtad pa la 'khyud par bsam/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes bum chu 'thor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ gsang dbang gi don du dbang lha yab yum dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa de'i lcer bzhag /byang chub sems ni rin chen 'bar byung ba// ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi lus bskams la// rnam dag rdo rje las byung ye shes chu// dri med rin chen spyi nas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma rā dza bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes sbyin/ sher dbang gi don du/ gtso bo yab yum las spros pa'i rig ma dang dbang lha'i yum tha mi dad pa gtad la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu nang du chud par blta// bhañdza mok+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs par bsam/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ zhes lung bstan/ dbang gi lha rnams rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bstim/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu// dngos 'byor yid kyis rab sprul pa'i// mchod yon rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin mchod yon mal du/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ pad+ma can la sogs pa yi// phyag rgya'i 'khyud sbyor bde ba che// zhing bcu rlung dang rtog pa sgrol// sbyor sgrol mchod pa bla na med// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// gong gi sngags mthar/ a nu rā ga ya u gra ma ra ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sman raka gtor gsum ni/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchog /rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen po// ba liṃ gtor mar bcas pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// sngags mthar/ sarba a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta zhes sbyar la mchod/ bstod pa ni/ e/ chos kyi bstod ring 'di bskul dang sbrags ma yin pas drag las ma gtogs 'jam gsum la 'thad par mi sems pas/ 'dir rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bstod pa'am/ rgyal mtshan me long gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bstod pa'am/ phreng ba 'dzin pa sogs gang rung sbyar na legs par 'dug go// mchan/ dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas// zhes sogs bstod ring gi mthar/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pa'i bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod do// bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/

gser gyi thur mas dngul snod du gnas pa'i mig sman sbrang rtsis sbyangs pa blangs nas thogs la/ rgyal ba mkha' la byon pa gser mdog mdzes// 'phags pa'i spyan la rab rib mi mnga' yang*// sems can rnams kyi ma rig bsal slad du// gser gyi thur mas rgyal ba'i spyan dbye bas// 'gro ba ye shes spyan lnga thob par shog /oṃ nirmā ṇa kā ya tsak+ṣuḥdzñā na a hoḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams| |sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣuḥbi sho dha na ye swā hā/ lan gsum bya/ bdag cag yon mchod la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la thugs rje'i gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur par bsam/ slar zhal bsgyur gyi sngon du mchod bstod ni/ hoḥ nyon mongs dri bral ar+ghaṃ mchod yon dang*// dbang po tshim byed 'bar ba'i bdug spos dang*// mdangs ldan 'od chags mdzes pa'i me tog dang*// 'khor ba'i mun sel snang byed zhun me dang*// mkhyen gsal rtog med dri chab 'khyil ba dang*// longs spyod bza' ba sna tshogs zhal zas dang*// stong nyid don ston shes rab rol mo'i sgra// mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang*// dwangs ba'i dri dang bcud 'dzin ro dang reg /dug lnga rang grol 'chi med bdud rtsi sman// snang srid snod bcud rdzogs pa'i gtor chen po// chags med yul dag rā ga rak+ta ste// 'khor ba bla med gnas spor ta na dang*// chos nyid dbyings su shar ba ga ṇa ste// phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon du ma'i tshogs// khro rgyal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mchog thun dngos grub dam pa deng stsol cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ rū pa/

shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ a mṛ ta/ rak+ta/ ba ling+ta ta na ga ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod/ bstod pa ni/ gti mug las kyis rmongs pa'i sems can kun// mi shes 'ching ba'i dri ma sel mdzad pa// sgrib gnyis rab sel rnam dag skyon bral sku// mun sel nyi 'od 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// nges bcom legs ldan mtshan bzhi'i mtha' las 'das// bdud dang gshin rje la sogs kun gyi gshed// ru tra gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun 'dul ba// thugs rjes sgrol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab chen pos nam mkha' nyi bzhin gsal// byang chub sems kyi 'od zer dbyings su 'char// dpa' brtul myur ba'i shugs kyis dregs pa sgrol// bdud 'dul dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las// bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur bstan pas// thugs rje'i gzi ldan gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen rab 'bar gshin rje 'joms mdzad lha// nyi ma 'bum las lhag pa'i 'od 'bar zhing*// gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// rab 'jigs gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag mthong gang gis nges par gsal ba'i sku// the tshom rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod pa'i gsung*// mkhyen gsal ye shes phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i thugs| |gdul bya'i bsam pa yid bzhin skong ba'i mdzod// rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa po// skye 'gag mtha' bral khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// blo rab mos pas 'dud phyag 'tshal bar bgyi// sbyor sgrol yum dang sras sprul 'khor gyi tshogs// skye med dbyings las 'gag med lhar snang ba// dbyings dang ye shes ngang rdzogs rol pa'i rtsal// 'khor bcas lhag pa'i lha la bdag phyag 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ zhal bsgyur ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs yongs su gyur pa las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur par bsam/

bcu gnyis pa brtan bzhugs ni/ mi shes 'dam bying 'khor ba 'dren pa'i gtso// nyon mongs chags bral rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs// gdul bya kun gyi don du thugs brtse bas// dus 'di nas bzung 'khor ba ma stong bar// bkra shis byin che bde legs mdzad phyir bzhugs// e a ra pa tsa na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma bzhag gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la 'byung ba sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar/ de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'ang gsum bya/ brtan bzhugs gong 'og gnyis ka'i tshe me tog 'thor rol mo bsgrag go// bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul ba la/ mchod bstod/ bye brag nyer mkho/ sbyin sreg /sngags dang bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba ste bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mngal dbul ba la/ mchod pa gsar pa rgyas par bshams la/ dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi mal du/

zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi mal du/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rnam gsum gzugs kyi tshogs// snang stong gzugs kyi rdo rje mar sprul nas// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bdag 'bul gyi// gzugs snang gzugs kyi rdo rjer rtogs par shog /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du gzugs kyi gnas su/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ dang*/ snang stong gi gnas su/ grag stong*/ tshor stong*/ myong stong*/ reg stong*/ dang*/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she'i bar sbyar ba dang*| stong gsum phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas su// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo rin po che// dpag yas 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu// 'khor los sgyur rgyal lha mi'i ston par dbul// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ nor bu/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo/ s+t+rī/ blon po/ pa ri ṇā ya ka/ glang po/ hasti/ rta mchog /tu raṃ ga a shwa/ dmag dpon/ se na pa ti kā ya pa ti/ zhes sbyar ba dang*/ gang gi mthong thos reg na bde ba'i tshogs// dpag yas skyed byed rdo rje sgeg pa ma// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun bkang ste// rgyal ba sras bcas mchod phyir bdag gis dbul/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra hā s+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ phreng ba ma/ mā le/ glu dbyangs ma/ gī ti/ gar mkhan ma/ lā s+ya/ me tog ma/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos ma/ dhū pe/ snang gsal ma/ dī paṃ/ dri chab ma/ gan+dhe/ zhes sbyar ba dang*/ nang mchod ni/ rdo rje pad+ma rab sbyar snyoms zhugs pa'i// bde chen dwangs ma'i me tog shu kra na// rgyal ba rab 'byams dgyes pa bskyed phyir dbul// bzhes nas bde chen dga' bde'i mchog grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā su khaṃ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du/ rkang pa gnyis pa rnams su/ tsaṇ+ḍas rab tu bsregs pa dwangs ma'i spos// dkar dmar 'dres pa'i rang mdangs 'od gsal me// byang sems dbu mar bab pa rdo rje'i dri// 'pho med bde chen dga' skyed chags pa'i zas// snyoms 'jug bde chen gzhom med nā da'i sgra// zhes dang*/ sngags la/ dhū paṃ/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ gsang mchod ni/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir mkhas shing*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos bde ster ma// rmad byung dga' skyed pad+ma can la sogs// phyag rgya rnam lnga las chos gtum mo dang*// ye shes ngo bo sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum// snying rje'i ngang las chags pa'i khro tshul can// rab dga' sprul nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs// zag med dgyes pa bskyed phyir sku dang sbyor// 'pho med bde bas lha rnams dgyes skong gyur// 'gro kun dpe yi lhan skyes rtogs par shog /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul gzung dang 'dzin// rang rig gdod nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// chu zla'i gar bzhin khyab la de ngor snang*// shar grol 'dzin med don gyi mchod pa 'bul// don dam lhan skyes rtogs pa'i mchog stsol cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā mu dra pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ rang byung gdod nas rnam dag sman chen po// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i ro// nyon mongs dug lnga gnas 'joms rigs lnga'i dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs dngos grub dam rdzas 'di| |'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum sras sprul 'khor// rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhing rdul grangs snyed la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

hoḥ nyon mongs 'khor ba bsgral ba'i dmar chen po// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum sbyar ba'i ru dhī ra// 'khor ba gnas 'joms ma hā rak+ta'i rgyun// dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// gzung 'dzin chags pa der 'dzin dang bcas pa// chags med bde chen sa ru bsgral du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum dang mnyam bhan+dha mtshan ldan du// 'bru bcud sha khrag dmar chen gtor ma che// dam rdzas kun 'dus khro rgyal 'khor bcas la// 'bul gyi bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes rgyas par dbul/ bstod pa ni/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab tu brgyan// 'jig rten gti mug mun sel ba// 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /'od bzang ston ka'i zla ltar dkar// nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od 'dra'i sku// phyag sor 'brel la sen sha dmar// rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang khyod la 'dud// shes rab chen pos skad cig gis// chos kun khong du chud pa po// mi shes nyon mongs g.yul ngo sel// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// sems can kun la byams ldan 'dud// mi shes mun sel ral gri dang*// shes rab po ti thugs btags lung*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa po// skye med zug rngu spangs la 'dud// rnam snang la sogs dbu rgyan 'chang*// 'khrul pa mi mnga' nor ba spangs// the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa// thams cad mkhyen cing de nyid ston// chos dbyings 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// nyi zla lta bur mun pa sel// 'gag med ngang du gsung dang thugs// mngon par rdzogs shing skye 'gag spangs// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba sgrol// longs spyod mkhyen gsal khyod la 'dud// 'dod pa'i don grub gter chen mdzod// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod skong*// dbul po ser snas bcings rnams kyi// de yi ser sna gcod mdzad pa// 'jam dbyangs dgos 'dod stsol la 'dud// kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang*| |rtag tu snying rje'i don dang ldan// shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs// mi shes srid pa'i dra ba gcod// thugs rje'i brtse ldan khyod la 'dud// ma rig 'khor ba'i sems can rnams| |las kyi nyon mongs 'dam du bying*// thugs rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis// de dag 'dren la rtag brtson pa// myur ldan brtson 'grus mchog khyod 'dud// gti mug las kyis rmongs pa'i sems can kun// mi shes 'ching ba'i dri ma sel mdzad pa// sgrib gnyis rab sel rnam dag skyon bral sku// mun sel nyi 'od 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud| |ces zla gsang man ngag gi 'dus pa'i tan+t+ra rgyud kyi le'u so bdun pa nas gsungs pa'i bstod pa dang*/

slar yang spyi bstod bya bar spro na/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems can las kyi chu bor nub pa la// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa sogs sbyar bas bstod do// gnyis pa bye brag nyer mkhos mnga' 'bul ba la/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor khri khrus na bza' dang*// rnam lnga rin chen bdun brgyad bcud// gdugs sogs rnam ni spyi yi'o// gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa dbul zhing*/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing la dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra su re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gdan khri la/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri| |yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral rgyal ba mchog la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog

/oṃ singha ā sa na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dri bzang gi chus| stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ su gan+dha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ na bza'/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ was+t+ra ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// phul bas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal srid bdun/ mi dbang rin chen rnam bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus par// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// oṃ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga mtshan lnga/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ pañtsa pañtsa bi ma le pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gdugs sogs/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan can// ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

bye brag sku gzugs spyi la ni/ smang bzed tshems shing spabs bzhar ro// shangs spu 'thog tshul/ rgyal ba'i shangs la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can kun gyis dri dbang thob bya'i phyir// gser gyi smang bzed shangs kyi spu btogs pas| |dri zhim ngad pas khams gsum rgyal gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra gan+dha sarba hoḥ tshems shing*/ tshems mnyam bzhi bcu nyon mongs skyon bral yang*// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad gcod phyir// dngul gyi thur mas tshems kyi dri bsal gyi// 'gro ba'i gzung 'dzin log rtog rtsad gcod shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dhā ya hoḥ spabs bzhar/ rgyal ba'i snyan la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang*| |sems can kun gyis sgra dbang thob bya'i phyir// gser gyi thur mas snyan spabs bsal bar bgyi// 'gro bas rtag tu chos sgra thos par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra dzñā na dharma gī ti hoḥ gong gi sdom du ma mthus kyang ljags bzhar thogs nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung la mnyel 'grib mi mnga' yang*// 'gro bas ma chags gsung lnga thob pa'i phyir// gser gyi ljags bzhar dri ma bsal bar bgyi// 'gro bas theg gsum chos sgo smra bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ma nu sarba dharma a hoḥ longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams la// so mang dang ni khyad par rgyan// so mang*/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*// 'gro bas mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs thob bya'i phyir// dung gi so mang dbu skra bshad pa yis// 'gro bas zag med longs sku thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra sam+bho ga kā ya u dzhi n+yā ya hoḥ rgyan rnams/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan zhing*// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis// mtshan dpe ldan pa'i lus mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā laṅkā ra bi bhū ṣa ṇa ā hūm̐/ zhes so/ */'di'i shangs spu 'thog pa phyin dang so mang gi bar gyi tshigs bcad rnams rab gnas dkyus ma'i tshigs bcad dang mi mthun pa ni zla gsang man ngag gi rgyud kyi dbang po skyon sbyang gi le'u so brgyad pa ltar bkod pa yin no// mchan/

sprul sku'i cha byad can rnams la// spu gri breg spyad chos gos snod// spu gri/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang*// gzhan don sgrub cing khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir// dad pas gser gyi 'breg spyad phul ba yis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu la āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sen mo 'breg spyad/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang*// bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi// sen mo 'breg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra na kha ts+tshe da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ snam sbyar/ dri med mtshan la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ghā ṭī āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhung bzed/ ji ltar rgyal po chen po bzhi po yis// de bzhin gshegs la lhung bzed phul ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir// yon tan snod du gyur pa dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra su ṣa pa tra kā rā ya āḥhūm̐/ skabs 'dir rab gnas gzhan du khro bo'i mnga' dbul ma byung bas 'dir sngags rnying ma'i rab gnas 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ba ltar sbyar ba ni/ thod skam dbu rgyan mgo phreng gnyis// glang chen mi dang stag lpags dang*// sbrul thal rak+ta zhag gdan me// mchod pa rol mor bcas khro bo// thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ don dam bcud kyi yon tan mthar phyin pa'i/ thod skam rat+na'i rtse bran dbu rgyan lnga// phul bas 'gro ba'i phung po lnga dag nas// rgyal ba lnga yi go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sho ṣa ya shīr+ṣa a laṅkā ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā| thod skam phreng ba/ gang gi bde ba skyong ba rdo rje'i phreng*// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbu la deng 'bul gyi// 'gro ba'i phrag dog rlung 'tshub rab zhi nas// bya ba grub pa'i go 'phang thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra ka pā la shuṣ+ka mā lā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgo phreng*/ mgo rlon khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i do shal ni// bcu phrag lnga ldan phreng ba 'bul lags kyi// 'gro ba'i 'du byed lnga bcu rab dag nas// ye shes rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra shīr+ṣa a ṭā mā' lā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ glang lpags/ theg mchog stobs bcus 'gro don bgyi slad du// so ldan dregs pa'i ko rlon 'di phul bas// 'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa rab zhi nas// chos dbyings dag pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra hasti tsarma aṃ wa ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mi lpags/ nyon mongs rtsad gcod gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir// mi lpags g.yang gzhi brjid ldan 'di phul bas// 'gro ba'i 'dod chags rgya mtsho gnas bskams te// sor rtog pad+ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra na ra a dzi na aṃ wa ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ stag sham/ phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don bgyi slad du// rab 'jigs stag gi sham thabs 'di phul bas// 'gro ba'i nga rgyal ri bo bsnyil byas nas// mnyam nyid nyi ma'i go 'phang thob par shog |oṃ badz+ra byā gh+ra a dzi na aṃ wa ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sbrul chun/ dpal brjid mnyen lcug gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// lto 'gro rnam lnga'i chun po 'di phul bas// 'gro ba'i zhe sdang me tshogs rab gzhil nas// me long thugs kyi go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañtsa bhu dzaṃ ga a laṅkā ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thal chen/ 'dul byed phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar// thal chen tshom bu bhan+dha'i dbyibs lta bu// smin mtshams sku yi sul rnams byugs pa yis// 'gro bas phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā bi bhū ta le ba āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rak+ta/ dug gsum dbang sdud snying rje chen po'i rtags// rak+ta'i thig le kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lta bus// mkhur tshos dpral ba'i dbyis su byugs pa yis// 'gro bas dmigs med snying rje rtogs par shog

/oṃ badz+ra ma hā ru dhī ra te kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhag chen/ 'gro ba'i don rnams thabs kyis mdzad pa'i brdar// zhag chen zo ris rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i// dbyibs can brang dang lkog mar bshal ba yis// 'gro bas don gnyis mthar phyin thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā rā sa kha tsi ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gdan/ dregs pa kun sgrol dgra bgegs dbang sdud phyir// pad zla nyi ma dbugs bral rngam pa'i gdan| |dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs la 'bul lags na// 'gro bas bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa thob shog /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma tsan+d+ra sūrdza ma hā ti ra ā sa na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me dpung*/ ye shes rab 'bar rang 'od rdo rje'i me// sreg za'i phung po dus mtha' ltar 'bar ba// snying rjes khros pa'i sku la bdag 'bul gyi// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tshang tshing sreg par shog /oṃ badz+ra dzñā na a na la āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod pa/ khro rgyal tshogs rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen rak+ta dang*// dam rdzas gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas// 'bul gyis 'gro ba'i 'dod yon lhun grub shog /oṃ badz+ra pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo/ rlung sngags rang sgra rnga dung cha lang dril// thod rnga rkang gling gzhom med nā da'i sgra// 'brug stong lta bu khro rgyal tshogs la 'bul// 'gro bas nges don sgra dbyangs rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā shapad pū dza āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsung rab la khri na bza' dang*// glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go// khri ni/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad la| spros bral gsung rab zhes bsgyur/ na bza'/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar zhes gong ltar/ glegs shing*/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*// thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i| |nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dga' bya ba// phul bas skye bos zu+ung 'jug rtogs par shog

/oṃ badz+ra pradzñā u pa ya a dā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ glegs thag /spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*| |ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar// glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas// 'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka bhan+dha na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ khyad par mchod rten rnams la ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod pan 'phan// rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan// srog shing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ sems can shes bcu ldan gyur cig /bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog |sems can lhag bsam dag pa yi// kun bzang smon lam 'jug par shog /'khor lo/ oṃ pra marda nā ya swā hā/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni| |dran pa nyer bzhag rnam thar brgyad// ye shes bzhi sogs ldan gyur cig /cod pan/ oṃ paṭ+ṭa lam+ba nā ya swā hā/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pa// bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la// dar dang lhab lhub la sogs pas// byang chub bar du mchod par shog /'phan sogs/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ ka swā hā/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pa// phyogs bcur snyan pa'i ba dan gyis// 'tshe ba med cing chos ldan pa'i// grags pas rgyas par 'gengs par shog /rgyal mtshan/ oṃ kum+bhi ra dh+wa dzā ya swā hā/ 'khor ba ma stong bar du ni// bdud bzhi dag las legs rgyal nas// ston pa'i bstan pa zab mo dag /mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar shog /gdugs/ oṃ pra ma nā ya swā hā/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// nyon mongs tsha bas gdungs pa la// thugs rje byang chub sems kyi gdugs// phul bas bde bas tshim par shog /phreng ba/ oṃ rat+na mā le traṃ na mas+t+rai ya dha a ma nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭha te puṣ+pe ke ta we/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun// mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs thob nas// blta bas mi ngom gzugs kyis ni// sems can don rnams rdzogs byed shog

/gdan rnams/ oṃ pu na dha ri dza ye swā hā/ sems can ma lus sangs rgyas te// stobs bcu ldan pa'i glang po'i gdan// mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan dang ldan// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rta yi gdan// dbang bcu thob pa rma bya'i gdan// thogs med shugs ldan mkha' lding gdan// 'dod dgu 'byung ba rin chen gdan// skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan// rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla'i gdan// gdan rnams myur du thob par shog /ces so// gsum pa sbyin sreg gam tsā ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba ni/ grub na skabs 'dir lha tshim pa'i slad du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ ma grub na snod bzang po'i nang du lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i mthar bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs bshams la/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i longs spyod lha'i zhal zas bza' bca' btung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid+yā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ di bya an+ni sa mā dhi dh+yā na pri ṇa ni swā hā/ zhes dbul zhing de rnams kyi phud bsdus pa rten gyi mdun du bsham/ bzhi pa bkra shis dang rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rin po che'i snod du nas gtsang ma blugs pa stegs kyi khar bzhag pa'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi srad bu btags pa bzhag pa'i sne slob dpon gyis bzung la/

me tog gi steng du zla ba'i dbus su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi mthar rab gnas kyi sngags rnams gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ me tog la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ ye dharma btags pa mang du bzlas nas/ mthar/ zla ba sngags dang bcas pa me tog la thim pas sngags kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ gser/ dngul/ tsan+dan sogs kyi byang bu'am gro ga la/ ga pur/ gi waṃ/ tsan+dan dkar po rnams kyis rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun dbu chen bris pa'i tshar re re la de nyid bdun re yan gang 'grub bzlas la btab nas bum pa'i chus bkrus te chu de nyid bum par blug /bum pa'i steng du zla ba'i dbus su sngags phreng gsal btab la de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas sngags phreng la thim par bsam zhing sngags bzla/ slar/ bum steng gi zla ba sngags bcas zhu ba bum chu dang 'dres par bsam zhing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas bum pa la reg nas sngags brgya phrag sogs bzlas la/ bum chu de nyid sngar bsgrubs pa'i me tog la bran la shis brjod kyi skabs su 'thor ro// de rjes rten la gzung thag btags la/ rten gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su sngags phreng gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid dang mthun pa'i gzugs kyis byon pa rnams rten la thim par bsam zhing*/ sku gzugs yin na/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha kā ya badz+ra ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ gsung la wāka/ mchod rten la tsit+ta/ gtsug lag khang dang phreng sogs la/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhū khaṃ badz+rī bha wa dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ de thams cad kyi mthar/ ye dharma btags pa mang du bzla ba gal che'o// mthar rol mo dang bcas shis pa brjod pa ni/

bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can// tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer gnyan ldan du// shing mchog ta la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can// tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na ka na'i grong khyer du// puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can// tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer gnyan yod du// shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni stobs ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du// shīr+ṣa yi drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du// u duṃ wā ra'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can// tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na wā rā ṇa sī ru// n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'gro mgon shāka thub rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can// tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer na// a shwat+tha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bkra shis sangs rgyas bdun gyi bkra shis phun tshogs gang yin dang*// phyogs bcu kun gyi bde gshegs byin rlabs rmad byung dang*// chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel stobs ldan mi 'gyur bas// deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs ldan shog

/ces dang*/ gzhan yang shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing me tog gi char dbab/ ye dharma bzla/ rol mo bsgrag /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ bstod par 'os pa'am/ 'dud nyi shu pas skabs 'dir mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o// spyi don gsum pa mjug gi sdom ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo// dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod// rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo// slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya// slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod// rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no// dang po gtor ma gtang ba ni/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras sprul gyi sngags mthar gtor sngags btags pas 'bul/ de rjes las gshin dang phyogs skyong bco lnga rnams la dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar gtor ma 'bul lo// gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma sha khrag dang dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa rgya cher bshams la/ chos skyong mdun du bskyed nas phrin las gzhung bsrang gtor 'bul rgyas par byas rjes/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma che ge mo khyod kyis rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa'i rten ji srid kyi bar du srung ba dang skyong bar gyis shig /ces brjod/ rdo rje go cha'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ chos skyong gi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che| |sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// rigs rnams myur du brlag par mchi'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag /srung ma khyod kyis bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*/ bskyang ba dang*/

bsam pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang*/ rten 'di la'ang mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyis shig |ces bsgo/ gsum pa bum mdun gyi lha mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar rab sbyar ba'i// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes la dngos grub deng stsol cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin mchod yon gyi mal du/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi mal du/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod| bstod pa ni/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan cing*// 'jig rten gti mug mun sel ba// 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mche ba gtsigs shing bsgrims pa yis// 'jigs pa'i tshul gyi sku yis ni// gshin rje dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa// gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug dag pa las byung zhing*// gti mug mchog ldan rdo rje'i sku// chos dbyings ye shes de bzhin rigs// phyag rgya zil gnon la phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags dag pa las byung zhing*// 'dod chags mchog ldan rdo rje'i gsung*// sor rtog ye shes pad+ma'i rigs// sbyor ba'i yum chen la phyag 'tshal// nga rgyal dag pa las byung zhing*// nga rgyal mchog ldan yon tan sku// mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rigs// ya ma rā tsa la phyag 'tshal// zhe sdang dag pa las byung zhing*// zhe sdang mchog ldan rdo rje'i thugs// me long ye shes rdo rje'i rigs// 'chi bdag nag po la phyag 'tshal// phrag dog dag pa las byung zhing*| |phrag dog mchog ldan phrin las sku// bya grub ye shes las kyi rigs// srog gi bdag po la phyag 'tshal// gzung 'dzin dag pa las byung zhing*// gzung 'dzin mchog ldan sprul pa'i sku| |gcig nyid du mar rab snang ba// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod nas/

dgra bgegs gdug pa sogs dang*/ lha yi lha mchog sogs dang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa sogs/ lnga brgya dus sogs/ bdag kyang sogs/ bgegs dang log par sogs/ nam mkha' med par sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ tsā ru'i lhag ma rnams drang zhing*/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// gsol zhig sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur// zhes brjod cing longs spyad/ tshogs lhag kyang dbul lo// bzhi pa bum mdun gyi lha la bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kun// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// nongs gyur de dag bzod par rigs// kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru// yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// lha rnams kun gyi sku gzugs la// bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang*// mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol// dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas ni// slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi// bu dang tsha bo srung mdzad cing*// rang gnas dge bar gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ ras bris sogs brtan bzhugs byas kyang nyan no// lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ sbyin bdag bos la/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par tshar ba byas kyi/ khyod kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par mchod par gyis shig /ces bsgo/ yon bdag gis rten gyi drung du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bshams/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa de rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas yon bdag 'bul du gzhug cing*/

yon bdag gis rten la phyag dang skor ba byed du gzhug go// drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ yon bdag las bum gyi chus khrus byed bcug /dbang thob nas lhar bskyed/ me tog lag tu gtad la/ spro na/ sngar rten gyi bgegs sbyong ba'i skabs ltar khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya/ mi spro na/ bkra shis pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sarba bigh+nāṃ uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dang*/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du thog mar rten la dbul/ de rjes dpon slob kun gyis reg cing yon bdag la gtad la/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pas// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa me long gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug tu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ glang po che nor skyong gis gi waṃ phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa gi waṃ gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig

|sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa zho'i rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /durbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūrba phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa dūrba'i rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos| |'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang don ni kun 'grub shog /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ lha tshangs pas shing tog bilba phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa bilba'i rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe dbang thob gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ lha'i dbang po rgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa dung dkar gyi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig
