/sngon yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ bram ze dkar rgyal gyis li khri phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa li khri'i rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs ni thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi gyur cig /sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas gyi mdun du mchod pa bshams pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bsod nams zhing du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas la// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod yon 'di// snang stong dbyer med dad pas 'bul lags na| |bde stong gnyis med thugs kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin mchod yon gyi mal du/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas| kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur// e ma hoḥ

shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi ngang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa// dam tshig mchog gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// yang dag ye shes dam pa ste// lan gcig tsam ni brjod pas kyang*// gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// bstod par 'os pa sogs sbyar bas bstod do// brgyad pa bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// kyai/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs bdag dgongs gsol// dpa' chen khyod drin tshad med kyis// bdag cag nyon mongs dgra las rgyal// legs so mgon po khyod legs so// e ma hoḥrdo rje'i thugs sangs rgyas// e ma hoḥ.e waṃ rdo rje'i chos// e ma de sgrub dge 'dun tshogs// skyabs gsum rdo rje khyod gcig 'dud// sa gsum mkha' spyod gnas gsum dang*// sgo gsum rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs// mngon sum zab cing dri bral dang*// ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o// de phyir bdag dang 'gro kun gyis// bgyis dang bgyi 'gyur dge chen 'di// 'od gsal bde chen rnam mi rtog /sku gsung rnam dag mthar phyin shog /skye zhing skye ba kun tu yang*// rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// lag na rdo rje'i dril 'dzin cing*// zag med bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /dri med rang byung skyob bde dang*// bdag bde 'dus ma byas gang zag /dkyil 'khor mchog tshogs mi bslu ba'i// bden pa dngos grub mchog thob shog /thub bstan phyogs brgyar sogs dang*/ zhes rdo rje theg pa'i bsngo ba rgya gar gyi slob dpon mi pham zla bas mdzad pa khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba 'di brjod cing gzhan yang skabs su bab pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o// dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa ni/

slob dpon la ci 'byor ba'i yon dbul/ bcu pa dga' ston ni/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs la chos ston dang*/ khyim pa rnams la sbyin pa sogs gang 'grub bya/ bcu gcig pa slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod pa ni/ yid bzang sbyin skyes mes po pad dkar mig /'ga' byed bde 'byung lto 'phyang bcud ldan dag /la sogs che dgu'i skra 'dzin gdan yangs po// rgyu byed legs par 'god mdzad ral gri can// gdug pa gzhom phyir khro chen dus 'dzin gshed// chos dbyings nam mkhar brtse chen dga' byed rgyas// thugs rje'i bde 'thung theg gsum sgra rgyas pa// skal bzang yid mtshor sprin gyi me tog dang*// log 'dren zhing du sdang byed lce 'bab pas// gang 'dul thabs kyis rab zhi rgyas mdzad cing*// reg 'phel rtsa lag kun nas 'joms mdzad pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i mthu des skyong gyur cig /'das dus rgyal ba klu yi rigs mchog ces| |ma 'ongs dus su mgon po kun tu gzigs// da lta 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshul// sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes bzlums de yi// rmad byung thugs rjes dge legs shis pa stsol| |bcom ldan gshin rje gsang bdag rdo rje rnon// dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs// shan+tiṃ gar+bha ye shes snying po dang*// nam mkha'i snying po khrag 'thung nag po'i mtshan| |gtsug lag dpal dge slob dpon pad+ma 'byung*// ba su dha ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// gter ston chen po dum pa zhang khrom sogs// dkyil 'khor kun gtso dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs dpal 'bar ye shes rdo rje'i mthus// don gnyis mthar phyin phun tshogs dge legs stsol// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa// chos dbyings don dam rdo rje ye shes mes// ma rig tshang tshing sreg mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas// gtso mchog 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon la// dpag yas yon tan tshad med mnga' ba'i mthus// lus can rnams kyi rgud pa kun bsal nas// dpal 'byor phun tshogs mchog la rtag rol cing*// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// sor rtog ngo bo sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum// mnyam pa nyid dngos thugs kyi sras mchog dang*// me long ye shes sku sprul 'chi bdag gtso// nan tan srog gi bdag po la sogs la// dpag yas yon tan tshad med mnga' ba'i mthus// lus can rnams kyi rgud pa kun bsal nas// dpal 'byor phun tshogs mchog la rtag rol cing*// don gnyis
